notes.title: Bugsnax 60% off in Creature Collector Fest!
notes.content:
Join us from May 12- May 19 to celebrate Steam's Creature Collector Fest! 

The day has finally come! Bugsnax is featured in an event all about collecting creatures. 

Fill up your Snak Pack with little guys, and feed them to the inhabitants of Snaktooth Island. You can collect Bugsnax. You can collect Bugsnax with cute hats. You can collect Bugsnax with a cute hat that is a thinly veiled One Piece reference. 

You can collect decor and trinkets for your home, which are not creatures. You can make friends with grumpuses who have serious emotional baggage they need to work through, which is kind of like collecting creatures when you really think about it. All of this and more for $10 USD! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/674140/Bugsnax/

Don't forget to check out all the other cool games being featured. If you liked Bugsnax, you'll probably like a lot of games featured during this event.

notes.title: Announcing Free Bugsnax VR Update & Sale!
notes.content:
To celebrate 4 years since Bugsnax’s launch, we’re releasing VR on SteamVR for Windows as a free update for all of you. 

For those who own the game on other platforms or have never given Bugsnax a shot, we hope 60% off until 11/15 will mean you join us on Snaktooth Island!  

What began as a fun side project by one of our programmers has evolved into a free update for Bugsnax fans! Converting the game from flatscreen to VR felt like a natural fit, especially with the hands-on use of tools and traps that make catching Bugsnax so engaging. Plus, you can now compare your height with all the Grumpus characters. Hint: they’re taller than you think! 

Thank you to everyone who participated in our open beta and gave feedback and feature requests! It’s been awesome getting to hear from the VR community and introduce more of you to our goofy game. Fans have been asking for Bugsnax in VR since it launched, and at long last, you can now pet a Bunger up close and personal, in virtual reality.

While you’re here, we’ve also just opened shop for Bugsnax: The Card Game. If you’re a Bugsnax fan (or your kids are), you can now buy a physical copy of the game and have it shipped pretty much anywhere in the world. Show me the cards. 

Thanks for 4 incredible years and for loving our games as much as we love to make them

-The Young Horses


For the full FAQ and other useful information on Bugsnax VR, check our pinned thread in the Discussions tab of the Community Hub!

notes.title: 13th Studio Anniversary, a Daily Deal, and Bugsnax VR Beta!
notes.content:
HAPPY ANNIVERSARY TO US! 

Young Horses has been around 13 years, so to celebrate, we’re doing a Daily Deal on Bugsnax and Octodad, giving you access to Bugsnax VR in beta, and streaming Bugsnax on the Steam page for the first time!! 

Bugsnax VR is now available through a FREE beta update on the Steam Windows version. If you own the game, you get free access! If you don’t own the game, you get a massive discount on it and then free VR. We have been working on this as a side project for a while, which has been no easy feat since Bugsnax exists in a custom engine. All porting and small details have to be done from scratch. 

But we’ve reached the point we think it merits a public release. Before we officially do that on the Steam store page, we want to check for any major omissions and give our fans a chance to get their hands on it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042045/11ee89aa2d16d41079ff8785f1ae2eeb5d95cde7.png

Joining the Beta
To access it: install Bugsnax, right-click it within the library, and select Properties. Go to the Betas tab and enter the code “virtualreality”. Select **vrtest** from the dropdown and update the game. Launch SteamVR before opening Bugsnax to play in VR.

IMPORTANT: Please go to SteamVR Settings, select to Show Advanced Settings, and change the option  Dashboard >  “Present Non-VR Applications on Theater Screen Upon Launch” to “Off”. 

Because this test is being done on a beta, Steam does not know this is a VR game and will otherwise erroneously display screen transitions during loading periods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042045/808f7d386cc0300cc1db27ffe05b186d890376b1.png

FAQ
For the full FAQ and other useful information, check our pinned thread in the Discussions tab of the Community Hub!

What is supported by Bugsnax VR?
The game was primarily tested using Quest 2/3, Valve Index, and PSVR2 along with their respective controllers. Vive wands are not supported. Gamepad support is available for those who prefer to play without motion controllers.

The game offers both teleport and continuous movement options, as well as snap camera rotation with customizable degree settings. It can be played seated or standing, in room-scale or stationary setups. Left-handed mode is also available.

Will Bugsnax VR be coming to other platforms?
There are currently no plans for other platforms, including PSVR2, Meta Quest standalone, or Apple Vision Pro. Bugsnax was created using a custom game engine, making full porting time-consuming. We intend to update the Windows version of Bugsnax on Epic Games Store to include SteamVR support if our soft launch concludes successfully.

Which VR platform are you using?
We developed this off and on for a few years using OpenVR, which is the API developed for SteamVR. We have not switched to OpenXR, so running SteamVR is a requirement.

I have a Meta Quest, how can I play the game through SteamVR?
You can connect to SteamVR through Steam Link, Oculus Link, or Virtual Desktop.

What are the system requirements?
A high-end Windows gaming desktop PC with an NVIDIA 3000 series graphics card is recommended for best performance.

Where should I leave feedback about the VR update?
Please post issues in the Bugsnax Vr Beta thread in the Discussions tab. Keep in mind that this release is mostly feature-complete, and that we do not intend on doing any large-scale additions.

notes.title: Unveiling: The Isle of BIGSNAX!
notes.content:
We're extremely excited to announce that we're working on more content for Bugsnax! The Isle of BIGsnax update will be available for FREE next year when the game launches on Steam.
[previewyoutube=f8hedznsj6A;full][/previewyoutube]
Journey to a mysterious new island where the Bugsnax are truly enormous! You’ll need to master new mechanics like the Shrink Spice, which can cut the giant Bugsnax down to a catchable size. Joining you are Chandlo, Floofty, Triffany, and Shelda, who will explore both the island’s long-forgotten history, and more of their own personal stories.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042045/9e44bc10291796a5a115864d003f47991450659d.jpg
Back in Snaxburg, you’ll finally have your very own hut! You can take on challenges from your mailbox to earn furniture and accessories to customize your living space. These challenges put a few twists in the gameplay, and will shake up how you explore and catch!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042045/8362d3ad6ece9514d17e7e6e714b585fa556e57a.jpg
And last but not least; capture rare Bughats in order to dress up your favorite Bugsnax!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41042045/5f3ff5f6c04f5e2f1c9e5d915253516d7be681f2.jpg

As you can see, we’ve stuffed this update with a smorgasbord of content for new and returning players alike!


 A new biome to explore.
 A dozen fresh Bugsnax to capture and feed to your friends.
 Over 100 challenges and 30 quests. Nearly 200 decorations to collect and display.
 More delightful dialogue from our returning voice cast.

We’ve been so happy with the response to Bugsnax, and we’re excited to bring Bugsnax and this new content to Steam. There’ll be plenty more little updates and improvements to discover all across the game, so keep your eyes peeled!

AND if you're still reading this, consider adding the game to your wishlist! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/674140/Bugsnax/
